question_1.text: Why is reusing the same password dangerous?
choices: A. It makes websites load more slowly
B. One breached account can put your other accounts at risk
C. It prevents you from enabling 2FA
D. Password managers cannot save reused passwords

question_3.text: What is the main purpose of a password manager?
choices: A. To publicly share passwords between devices
B. To create, store, and autofill unique passwords securely
C. To remove the need for a master password
D. To store passwords in a regular document

question_4.text: How does two-factor authentication protect an account?
choices: A. It changes your password every day
B. It blocks all login attempts from new devices
C. It requires an additional verification step besides your password
D. It makes short passwords impossible to crack
